name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Detail when it is needed.
guidance: Use type="single" with collapsible or type="multiple". Every item needs a unique value. Triggers preserve heading and keyboard semantics.
example:
import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger } from "rillmark/accordion"

export default function ComponentDemo() {
  return <Accordion type="single" collapsible className="w-full max-w-lg">
    <AccordionItem value="ownership"><AccordionTrigger>Who owns the component source?</AccordionTrigger><AccordionContent>You do. Installation copies TypeScript into your project so your team can edit it directly.</AccordionContent></AccordionItem>
    <AccordionItem value="themes"><AccordionTrigger>Can we adapt the palette?</AccordionTrigger><AccordionContent>Yes. Update the semantic CSS variables in your stylesheet. Every component follows the same light and dark color relationships.</AccordionContent></AccordionItem>
  </Accordion>
}

name: alert-dialog
title: AlertDialog
description: A deliberate pause before a consequence.
guidance: Describe the consequence and provide Cancel and Action. Initial focus goes to Cancel. Never use this for routine success messages.
example:
"use client" import { useState } from "react" import { Button } from "rillmark/button" import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle, AlertDialogTrigger } from "rillmark/alert-dialog" export default function ComponentDemo() { const [archived, setArchived] = useState(false) return

{archived ? "Spring research was archived." : "Spring research is active."}

{archived ? : Archive Spring research?The project will leave your active list. You can restore it later. Keep active setArchived(true)}>Archive project }
}

name: alert
title: Alert
description: Feedback with enough context to act.
guidance: Use soft for information, accent for attention and danger for errors. Danger uses role=alert; other variants use status. Do not repeat static notices excessively.
example:
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from "rillmark/alert" export default function ComponentDemo() { return
Ready for the next chapterAll 12 observations have been reviewed. Your team can begin the synthesis. Two notes need attentionAdd a site location to each note before including it in your report.
}

name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: A recognizable presence, even without an image.
guidance: Compose AvatarImage with descriptive alt and AvatarFallback. If initials are the only name, give the Avatar a role="img" and aria-label.
example:
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from "rillmark/avatar" export default function ComponentDemo() { return
MCAONA

The research team

Maya, Ada, and Niko

}

name: badge
title: Badge
description: A small, readable signal.
guidance: Use text to identify the state. Color is supplemental. Badges are spans; use a Button for an interactive filter.

name: breadcrumbs
title: Breadcrumbs
description: A useful trail back.
guidance: Compose the list with real links and a final BreadcrumbPage. Separators are hidden from assistive technology.

name: button-group
title: ButtonGroup
description: Related actions, kept together.
guidance: Supply aria-label to explain the group. Use buttons for actions and Tabs for switching a content panel.
example:
"use client" import { useState } from "react" import { Button } from "rillmark/button" import { ButtonGroup } from "rillmark/button-group" export default function ComponentDemo() { const [period, setPeriod] = useState("Week") return
{["Week", "Month", "Year"].map((item) => )}

Showing this {period.toLowerCase()}’s activity.

}

name: button
title: Button
description: A clear next step, with quiet alternatives.
guidance: Use solid for the primary action, soft for a companion, outline for a boundary and ghost for a quiet action. Loading preserves the label and blocks repeated clicks.

props.name: loading
props.description: Keeps the label visible and prevents repeated submission.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Compose a single element, such as an anchor.

example:
"use client" import { useState } from "react" import { Button } from "rillmark/button" export default function ComponentDemo() { const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false) return

{saved ? "Your preferences are up to date." : "You have unsaved preferences."}

}

name: card
title: Card
description: A home for related information.
guidance: Compose Header, Title, Description, Content and Footer. Choose a heading level with CardTitle as="h2" (or h3–h6) appropriate to your page; Card itself is a plain div.
example:
"use client" import { useState } from "react" import { Badge } from "rillmark/badge" import { Button } from "rillmark/button" import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "rillmark/card" export default function ComponentDemo() { const [following, setFollowing] = useState(false) return FieldworkCoastal restorationFinding a better rhythm between our communities and the shore.

12 observations · 3 collaborators

 }

name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: An independent choice, clearly marked.
guidance: Supports checked, defaultChecked and onCheckedChange, including indeterminate state. Name the control with Field or aria-label.
example:
"use client" import { useState } from "react" import { Checkbox } from "rillmark/checkbox" export default function ComponentDemo() { const [checked, setChecked] = useState(true) return

{checked ? "You’ll receive the next summary." : "Summary emails are off."}

}

name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: Find a choice without losing your place.
guidance: Pass options with unique value and label. Typing filters; arrows move, Enter selects, Escape closes. Field supplies the accessible label. Use required when a real option must be selected.

api.name: Combobox
api.description: Searchable single selection. Focus stays in the input while the listbox is open.

example:
"use client"
import { useState } from "react"
import { Combobox } from "rillmark/combobox"
import { Field } from "rillmark/field"

const options = [{ value: "maya", label: "Maya Chen", keywords: ["research"] }, { value: "niko", label: "Niko Alvarez", keywords: ["design"] }, { value: "ada", label: "Ada Okafor", keywords: ["ecology"] }, { value: "leo", label: "Leo Park · away", disabled: true }]

export default function ComponentDemo() {
  const [owner, setOwner] = useState("")
  return <Field label="Project lead" description="Find a teammate by name or specialty." className="w-full max-w-sm">
    <Combobox options={options} value={owner} onValueChange={setOwner} placeholder="Choose a teammate" emptyMessage="No teammates match. Try a different name." />
  </Field>
}

name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: A focused task, with a clear way back.
guidance: Include DialogTitle and DialogDescription. The trigger receives focus again on close. Do not nest unrelated modal workflows.

Workspace: {saved}

A name for your workYour team will see this in their workspace switcher.
{ event.preventDefault(); setSaved(name.trim()); setOpen(false) }}> setName(event.target.value)} minLength={2} />
}

name: dropdown-menu
title: DropdownMenu
description: Actions, right where they belong.
guidance: Radix supports arrow keys, typeahead, checkbox/radio items and submenus. Use onSelect for actions; avoid nested interactive elements inside items.

Spring research Pin to overview setStatus("A copy of Spring research was created.")}>Duplicate project setStatus("Spring research was archived.")}>Archive project

{pinned ? "Pinned. " : ""}{status}

}

name: empty-state
title: EmptyState
description: A useful next step when there is nothing here.
guidance: Explain the current state and offer one relevant action. Distinguish an empty collection from a filter with no matching results.

name: field
title: Field
description: Labels, help and errors that stay connected.
guidance: Wrap one control per Field. Label, description and error props automatically connect to Rillmark controls. Always describe errors in text.

api.name: Field
api.description: A labeled control with automatically associated help and validation text.

api.name: useFieldControl
api.description: Used by Rillmark controls; also useful when adapting a custom control to Field.

name: icon-button
title: IconButton
description: A compact action with a name.
guidance: The label prop is required. Icons alone are not accessible names. Default to the 44px size for touch.

props.name: label
props.description: Required accessible name; tooltip is optional.

props.name: loading
props.description: Keeps the label visible and prevents repeated submission.

example:
"use client" import { useState } from "react" import { Bookmark } from "lucide-react" import { IconButton } from "rillmark/icon-button" export default function ComponentDemo() { const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false) return
setSaved(!saved)}> {saved ? "In your collection" : "Keep this project close"}
}

name: input
title: Input
description: A familiar place to begin.
guidance: Native input props and ref are supported. Use Field for a persistent label; placeholders are hints, not labels.

name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: Move through a manageable set.
guidance: Control page, pageCount and onPageChange. It disables boundary actions and announces page changes. Filter data before calculating the page count.

}

name: popover
title: Popover
description: Context within reach.
guidance: Small interactive supporting content. Use a Dialog for a task that requires a modal focus boundary. Label interactive controls inside the content.

name: progress
title: Progress
description: A sense of how far along.
guidance: Always supply aria-label or aria-labelledby. A null value is indeterminate. Explicit values are clamped between zero and max.
example:
"use client" import { useState } from "react" import { Button } from "rillmark/button" import { Progress } from "rillmark/progress" export default function ComponentDemo() { const [reviewed, setReviewed] = useState(6) return
Observation review{reviewed} of 12
`${value} of ${max} observations`} />
}

name: radio-group
title: RadioGroup
description: One choice from a visible set.
guidance: Label the group with Field, and each RadioGroupItem using a label or aria-label. Radix handles roving arrow-key focus.

name: select
title: Select
description: A focused list of choices.
guidance: Compose Select, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, SelectContent and SelectItem. Radix supplies typeahead and keyboard selection. Item values must be nonempty.
example:
"use client"
import { useState } from "react"
import { Field } from "rillmark/field"
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "rillmark/select"

export default function ComponentDemo() {
  const [region, setRegion] = useState("east")
  return <Field label="Research region" description="Your project’s primary field location." className="w-full max-w-sm">
    <Select value={region} onValueChange={setRegion}>
      <SelectTrigger><SelectValue placeholder="Choose a region" /></SelectTrigger>
      <SelectContent><SelectItem value="east">Eastern coast</SelectItem><SelectItem value="north">Northern highlands</SelectItem><SelectItem value="central">Central watershed</SelectItem><SelectItem value="south" disabled>Southern reserve · full</SelectItem></SelectContent>
    </Select>
  </Field>
}

guidance: Decorative by default. Set decorative={false} when the separator communicates a structural division to assistive technology.

name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: A little more room, alongside the work.
guidance: Built on the same Radix Dialog foundation. Use side="right" or side="left". Include SheetTitle and SheetDescription.
example:
"use client" import { useState } from "react" import { Button } from "rillmark/button" import { Field } from "rillmark/field" import { Switch } from "rillmark/switch" import { Sheet, SheetClose, SheetContent, SheetDescription, SheetFooter, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetTrigger } from "rillmark/sheet" export default function ComponentDemo() { const [digest, setDigest] = useState(true) return A quieter workspaceChanges apply immediately to this demo session.

Weekly digest is {digest ? "on" : "off"}.

 }

name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: A quiet placeholder for what comes next.
guidance: Skeleton is decorative and hidden from assistive technology. Mark the containing region aria-busy and provide a loading label. Motion stops under reduced motion.

api.name: Skeleton
api.description: Decorative placeholder. Give its containing region aria-busy and a loading label.

name: slider
title: Slider
description: Fine control across a range.
guidance: Values are number arrays, as in Radix. Use thumbLabels for multiple thumbs and a Field label for the overall control. Arrow keys adjust values.

props.name: thumbLabels
props.description: Accessible names for each thumb; particularly useful for range sliders.

name: switch
title: Switch
description: An immediate on or off decision.
guidance: Use checked/onCheckedChange or defaultChecked. Include a persistent label; use a checkbox for consent or form submission choices.

name: table
title: Table
description: Readable data, with room to grow.
guidance: Use a caption, scoped headers and aria-sort for sortable columns. The overflow region is keyboard focusable. Sorting, filtering and selection belong in the application.
example:
import { Badge } from "rillmark/badge" import { Table, TableBody, TableCaption, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "rillmark/table" const projects = [{ name: "Coastal restoration", lead: "Maya Chen", notes: 12, status: "In progress" }, { name: "Spring research", lead: "Ada Okafor", notes: 8, status: "In review" }, { name: "Watershed atlas", lead: "Niko Alvarez", notes: 24, status: "In progress" }] export default function ComponentDemo() { return Current research projects and their field notes.ProjectLeadStatusNotes{projects.map((project) => {project.name}{project.lead}{project.status}{project.notes})}
}

name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: One workspace, several views.
guidance: Compose TabsList, TabsTrigger and TabsContent with matching values. Label the list. Radix handles arrow keys, Home and End.
example:

 }

name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: Room for a longer thought.
guidance: A resizable native textarea. Use Field for a label and validation; retain resizing when space allows.

name: toast
title: Toast
description: An update that respects the current task.
guidance: Use ToastProvider and one ToastViewport. Control each Toast open state. Keep important errors visible inline too; transient messages are not a substitute for validation.
example:
"use client"
import { useState } from "react"
import { Button } from "rillmark/button"
import { Toast, ToastClose, ToastDescription, ToastProvider, ToastTitle, ToastViewport } from "rillmark/toast"

export default function ComponentDemo() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [revision, setRevision] = useState(0)
  return <ToastProvider>
    <Button onClick={() => { setRevision(revision + 1); setOpen(true) }}>Save changes</Button>
    <Toast key={revision} open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} variant="success">
      <ToastTitle>Changes saved</ToastTitle><ToastDescription>Your workspace preferences are up to date.</ToastDescription><ToastClose />
    </Toast>
    <ToastViewport />
  </ToastProvider>
}

name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A short, optional explanation.
guidance: Wrap the relevant tree in TooltipProvider. Trigger must be focusable and already have a name. Do not put essential instructions only in a tooltip.
example:
"use client"
import { useState } from "react"
import { Bookmark } from "lucide-react"
import { IconButton } from "rillmark/icon-button"
import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipProvider, TooltipTrigger } from "rillmark/tooltip"

export default function ComponentDemo() {
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false)
  return <TooltipProvider><Tooltip>
    <TooltipTrigger asChild><IconButton label={saved ? "Remove bookmark" : "Bookmark collection"} variant="outline" aria-pressed={saved} onClick={() => setSaved(!saved)}><Bookmark aria-hidden="true" size={18} fill={saved ? "currentColor" : "none"} /></IconButton></TooltipTrigger>
    <TooltipContent>{saved ? "Saved to your collection" : "Keep this collection close"}</TooltipContent>
  </Tooltip></TooltipProvider>
}
